meta.title: Add conditional runtime emission to OCaml compiler
meta.body_summary: Enhance OCaml backend with feature scanning to conditionally emit runtime helpers only when required by a program.

perf_labels.notes: Codex conditionally emits OCaml runtime helpers; single-commit 443-line change merged instantly by author without review or performance evidence.

change_scale_vs_repository.interpretation: At 443 changed lines in a single file, this is a medium-sized focused compiler refactor. The fast merge by the author suggests low risk and high trust.

review_details.concern_detail: No formal reviews or comments were recorded; the PR was merged directly by the author.
review_details.performance_claim: Emit OCaml runtime helpers only when required, reducing unnecessary code emission.

capability_boundary.boundary_notes: Compiler backend feature scanning and conditional emission are within Codex capability when the change is applied by a trusted maintainer; the PR demonstrates that Codex can implement meaningful compiler optimization without external review.

maintainer_practices.reproducibility_notes: No performance measurements or repro steps; only go vet invocation as testing.
maintainer_practices.regression_detail: No regressions reported; merge was immediate.

core_change_summary.description: In compiler/x/ocaml/compiler.go, added feature scanning to detect which runtime helpers are needed and emit them conditionally, removing unconditional emission (approximately 350 additions, 93 deletions).
change_trajectory: Single commit: introduced conditional runtime emission with feature scanning.

collaboration_trajectory: PR created by tamnd (OpenAI_Codex agent), merged instantly by the same user with no review interaction.
